parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description: The MIME type of the object to upload. Maximum length: 128 characters. This value is included in the UploadUrl signature. Use the same Content-Type when performing the PUT request.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The original file name of the reference file to upload. Maximum length: 255 characters. When singleTableFile uses a FileId, only CSV or XLSX files are supported.

parameters.name: SizeBytes
parameters.description: The size of the file to upload, in bytes. This value is recorded as attachment metadata. Specify the actual file size.
